Priya R: hey all :wave: i'm primary for tonight (18:00-02:00) but just got a doctor's appt that i can't move. need to swap primary window 18:00-23:00 to someone else. mike is already penciled for 23:00-02:00 if that helps. can @Dan K take 18:00-23:00? i can hand over context at 17:45. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall#network-deg
Dan K: i can take 18:00-23:00, i have pager access. quick q — any ongoing mitigation or open incidents i should be aware of? also confirm whether the dedicated pool for blue-region is on fallback mode this evening.
Priya R: no active incidents right now, last ticket (INC-4821) was closed at 16:30. blue-region had a transient latency spike earlier but it's stable; set to normal routing. i left notes in the runbook under "handovers/2026-03". i'll DM credentials to you for the troubleshooting jumpbox if needed. :+1:
OncallBot: @Dan K requested as primary for 18:00-23:00 (requested by Priya R). Please acknowledge by replying `ack` in this thread. Rotation calendar updated.
Dan K: ack. i'll also verify alerting thresholds and paging policy at 17:50. can someone confirm secondary for 18:00-23:00 (so mike can focus 23:00-02:00)?
Mike L: i'll be secondary for the whole night, covers 18:00-02:00 if anything escalates. i'll be on standby from home. ping me on mobile for anything high-sev.
Lee S: quick checklist — confirm pager escalation matrix, runbook step numbers, and access to `redwood-prod-jump` for Dan. Priya, can you paste the specific runbook snippet you want Dan to follow for a noisy model spike? avoids finger-pointing.
Priya R: sure — copying the minimal steps here:
```
1) check /infra/metrics -> model-serving/latency
2) if p95 > 800ms, switch routing to model-quant-2 for 10m: `rctl route set model=quant-2 --weight 0.9`
3) if error rate > 1% open incident and escalate to eng-runtime
4) run `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=router --tail=200` and paste top 3 error lines in the incident
``` 
Priya R: also note: for customer-impact assessment, use template at https://redwood.internal/incidents/templates/customer-impact and flag if >5% request drop.
Dan K: i have jumpbox access and iam role already. i'll run the checklist at 17:50 and DM handover notes. thanks for the snippet, Priya.
IncidentBot: Handoff created: primary changed to Dan K (18:00-23:00), secondary: Mike L (18:00-02:00). Handoff notes attached to INC-HO-202603 (internal ref). Pager rotations updated. :white_check_mark:
Priya R: beautiful, thanks everyone. i'll post a 17:45 mini-handoff in this thread (quick bullet points) and set an alarm. leaving my phone open during the appointment but prefer Dan to take live pages. :heart:
Dan K: thanks — see you at 17:45 for the preflight. i'll confirm once i finish the preflight checks. :thumbsup:
Mike L: got it. i'll monitor alerts and be ready to escalate. :eyes:
Priya R: (closing) preflight notes -> 1) no active deploys 2) blue-region stable 3) quota checks green. handing off now.
